fullPassage: To tantalize someone is to make them want something, often something they can never get. The word comes from the Greek myth of King Tantalus, who was so proud that he tried to fool the gods. When invited to eat with them, Tantalus stole their special food so that he could bring it to his friends. As a punishment, he was sent to the underworld. He had to stand in a pool of water with delicious ripe fruit hanging from a tree above him. Whenever he tried to drink the water, it would drain away. If he tried to pick the fruit, the branches would move out of reach. Tantalus was already in the underworld, so no matter how hungry or thirsty he got, he would never die.

det.tip: 주어가 동작을 받음 + 과거 → was + p.p. = was sent

questions.passage: To tantalize someone is to make them want something, often something they can never get. The word comes from the Greek myth of King Tantalus, who was so proud that he tried to fool the gods. When invited to eat with them, Tantalus stole their special food so that he could bring it to his friends. As a punishment, he was sent to the underworld. He had to stand in a pool of water with delicious ripe fruit hanging from a tree above him. Whenever he tried to drink the water, it would drain away. If he tried to pick the fruit, the branches would move out of reach. Tantalus was already in the underworld, so no matter how hungry or thirsty he got, he would never die.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 핵심: tantalize라는 단어가 탄탈로스 신화에서 유래함
det.analysis:
① 음식의 종류: 지엽적 소재일 뿐
② 다양한 형벌: 탄탈로스 한 명의 형벌만 다룸
③ tantalize의 어원이 된 탄탈로스 신화 ←정답
④ 저승 탈출 노력: 본문에 언급 없음
det.tip: 글 전체 = tantalize 단어의 유래(탄탈로스 신화) 설명

ch: 그리스 신화에 등장하는 신들의 특별한 음식의 종류
고대 그리스에서 신을 속인 자들에게 내려진 다양한 형벌
tantalize라는 단어의 유래가 된 탄탈로스 신화
탄탈로스가 저승에서 벗어나기 위해 기울인 노력

questions.passage: To tantalize someone is to make them want something, often something they can never get. The word comes from the Greek myth of King Tantalus, who was so proud that he tried to fool the gods. When invited to eat with them, Tantalus stole their special food so that he could bring it to his friends. As a punishment, he was sent to the underworld. questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: tantalize의 의미(얻을 수 없는 것을 갈망하게 함) + 탄탈로스 형벌 유래
det.analysis:
① '대부분의 영어 단어'로 과도한 일반화
② 탄탈로스는 죽지 않았으므로 '죽음'으로 이어진다는 진술은 오류
③ 음식 섭취로 불사? 본문 근거 없음(이미 저승에 있어 죽지 않을 뿐)
④ tantalize 의미 + 탄탈로스 형벌 유래 ←정답
det.tip: 첫 문장(단어 뜻) + 신화(유래) = 요지

ch: 그리스 신화는 대부분의 영어 단어의 어원이다.
신을 속이는 행위는 반드시 죽음이라는 결과로 이어진다.
신들의 음식을 먹은 인간은 영원히 죽지 않는다.
tantalize는 결코 얻을 수 없는 것을 갈망하게 만든다는 뜻으로, 탄탈로스의 형벌에서 유래했다.

'그가 그것을 (친구에게) 가져다줄 수 있도록'
[조건] (1) bring, could, he, it, so, that을 모두 사용

det.korean: so that + 주어 + could ~ = ~할 수 있도록 (목적)
